people.name: Giddalti
people.line: Son of Heman; a temple musician during David's reign.

translations.web: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
translations.bsb: the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
translations.kjv: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
translations.asv: for the two and twentieth to Giddalti, his sons and his brethren, twelve:
